corrections.title: 三洞群仙录
corrections.note: Schipper CT/DZ 1248 (CRTA, Pregadio, Bokenkamp et al.). DZ1238 is the Harvard-Yenching (HY) number, not Schipper.

corrections.title: 三坛圆满天仙大戒
corrections.note: Not in the Ming Daozang. Full title 三坛圆满天仙大戒略说 is Daozang jiyao only (JY ~285/Pregadio). DZ180 is 初真戒/初真十戒文 (Chuzhen jie).

corrections.title: 火师汪真君雷霆奥旨
corrections.note: Not an independent Daozang work. 汪火师雷霆奥旨 is fascicle ~76 of 道法会元; DZ1220 is the collection title Daofa huiyuan, not this tract alone.

corrections.title: 太上肘后玉经方
corrections.note: Schipper CT/DZ 847 (CRTA; Komjathy Title Index to Zhonghua Daozang). Companion/index sequence places it before 混俗颐生录 DZ848.

corrections.title: 太上洞玄灵宝三元品戒功德轻重经
corrections.note: Schipper CT/DZ 456 (CRTA, Komjathy, multiple Lingbao studies). DZ444 is 洞玄灵宝三师记.
